After these changes, buttons will once again use their native focus handling, and no invalid `focusable` attribute will ever be emitted on non-SVG elements.

With these two replacements:

- The `tabIndex: 0` default is gone, so unless you explicitly pass a `tabIndex` prop, no `tabindex` attribute will be rendered on the `<button>`.
- The `focusable="false"` prop is no longer injected unconditionally, so you will never end up with invalid `focusable` attributes on `<span>` (or other non-SVG) elements.
